notes: The €500 fee is named differently across pages: the DAAD page calls it 'Tuition fees per semester' for non-EU applicants while the university pages call it a 'service fee' for non-EU/EEA students; the value (EUR 500 / semester) is the same. A separate non-refundable application fee of €60 applies (DAAD: 'the application fee of 60 EUR'; DIT: 'Bewerbungsgebühr EUR 60'). This programme starts in the summer semester (March); the pages give the application period without a year (15 October - 1 December), so no absolute deadline year could be quoted. The programme's own page states 'Start March (summer semester)'. The DAAD page states the admission test covers Mathematics and Physics, the DIT page only Mathematics.
